bio: Housed in a glass and steel structure adjacent to the High Line and across from Little Island park, Genesis House is a cool and modern respite from the surrounding cacophony. The ground floor is a gallery of the brand's luxury cars, while the second floor is a stunning, expansive dining room delivering skyline views and modern Korean fare. Think curls of amberjack crudo in a kimchi and asparagus brine or a 36-hour beef bone broth that’s boldly seasoned with pepper. Desserts like pear sorbet with tapioca pearls, cinnamon and ginger make for a captivating ending. Beverages include a thorough wine list and premium teas from Korea....
